notes: Agent-portfolio = a programmatically-managed copy-trading portfolio with its own scoped user tokens
Scope IDs: 200 = etoro-public:real:read, 201 = etoro-public:demo:read, 202 = etoro-public:real:write, 203 = etoro-public:demo:write
userToken secret is ONLY returned at creation time (CreateAgentPortfolioUserTokenItem.userToken / CreateUserTokenResponse.userToken) — store it immediately, it cannot be retrieved later
investmentAmountInUsd is taken from the CALLER account; the agent-portfolio gets its own separate virtual balance (agentPortfolioVirtualBalance) for proportional position sizing

agentPortfolioId.description: The unique identifier of the agent-portfolio.

agentPortfolioName.description: The display name of the agent-portfolio.

agentPortfolioGcid.description: The GCID associated with the agent-portfolio.

agentPortfolioVirtualBalance.description: The fixed virtual balance (in USD) that the agent-portfolio was funded with. The investmentAmountInUsd used to copy is proportional to this balance.

mirrorId.description: The Trading API mirror ID for this agent-portfolio's copy trade.

userTokens.description: The user tokens associated with this agent-portfolio.

userTokenId.description: The unique identifier of the user token.

userTokenName.description: The user-defined name for the user token.

clientId.description: The OAuth client identifier associated with the user token.

externalApplicationName.description: The name of the external application registered for this token.

ipsWhitelist.description: The set of whitelisted IP addresses authorized to use this token.

expiresAt.description: The expiration date and time of the user token in UTC.

scopeIds.description: The set of permission scope identifiers granted to this token. Available scopes: 200 = etoro-public:real:read, 201 = etoro-public:demo:read, 202 = etoro-public:real:write, 203 = etoro-public:demo:write.

createdAt.description: When this user token was created.

agentPortfolios.description: The collection of agent-portfolios owned by the user.

investmentAmountInUsd.description: The amount in USD deducted from the CALLER's account balance to copy-trade this agent-portfolio. This is NOT the agent-portfolio's own balance — the agent-portfolio receives a separate fixed virtual balance (returned as agentPortfolioVirtualBalance). Positions are mirrored proportionally: e.g. $2,000 with a $10,000 virtual balance = 20% position sizing.
